05 / Additional Technology Services

The supporting work that keeps systems running and improving.

Cloud and DevOps, integration, data, consulting and ongoing technical support, arranged around what a project needs.

Discuss this serviceSee what is included
Portfolio to be confirmed

The situation

Most projects need more than one discipline. A new application needs somewhere to run, data to draw on and someone to look after it once it is live.

The services below are offered alongside our core work or on their own. Each is scoped individually.

Capabilities

What this service covers.

  • 01

    Cloud and DevOps

    Cloud environments, automated deployment and the operational practices that keep releases routine.

    • Cloud architecture and migration
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Infrastructure as code and monitoring

  • 02

    Business process consulting

    A structured look at how work moves through the business before deciding what to build or buy.

    • Process mapping
    • Requirements definition
    • Technology selection advice

  • 03

    System integration

    Connecting separate applications so data is entered once and available everywhere it is needed.

    • Integration design
    • Middleware and API connectors
    • Data synchronisation

  • 04

    Data engineering and analytics

    Reliable pipelines and reporting that turn operational data into something the business can read.

    • Data pipelines and warehousing
    • Dashboards and reporting
    • Data quality checks

  • 05

    Application maintenance and technical support

    Continued care for software already in use, including systems built by someone else.

    • Bug fixes and updates
    • Performance and security patches
    • Support arrangements by agreement

  • 06

    Digital transformation

    A staged plan for moving manual or paper-based operations onto connected digital systems.

    • Current-state assessment
    • Phased roadmap
    • Change support for teams

Delivery

From discovery through deployment and support.

Every engagement follows the same six stages, scaled to the size of the work.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Discovery and requirements.

  2. 02

    Design

    Solution design and planning.

  3. 03

    Build

    Development and implementation.

  4. 04

    Test

    Testing and quality assurance.

  5. 05

    Launch

    Deployment and handover.

  6. 06

    Support

    Ongoing support and optimization.

What you leave with

  • A scoped plan for the supporting work
  • Clear ownership of each component
  • Documentation for whoever maintains it next
